original_card.question: Can a template or call contract leave two or more unpaid coordinates per live family?
methods: State a replacement for the coverage identity (mass = 72W + 64N) and the contract change that realizes it, with its implementation cost.
Find an obstruction: show which data-endpoint obligation forces exactly one unpaid coordinate in the current template.
original_card.acceptance_gate: An explicit replacement identity, verified on a small complete instance with dirty inputs, priced with ceiling.ceiling(unpaid=...). A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Explain where the single unpaid coordinate per family comes from in the hosted template; propose one change and price it. Ideal budget: two unpaid coordinates per family is 3.77x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: The deficit is one coordinate per family minus the centre charge; doubling unpaid coordinates per family scales it directly.
allowed_variations: One template change or one endpoint-contract change.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Counting a coordinate as unpaid while leaving it unadvanced in the data endpoint.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: For every ordered directed 4-cycle on any four channels of the exact PR3335 rank-34 P112 factorization, can any rational coefficient choice in the four-shear cycle word lower the complete-plane one-total invoice?
scope_change_reason: The coverage-law card is narrowed to a concrete algebraic escape from the exhaustive rational pair and triple screens: noncommuting shears around a four-channel cycle. A symbolic path expansion classifies all rational support cells for this word family before exact tariff pricing.
bottleneck_link: A tariff below the inherited optimistic copy-screen allowance of 160 would justify a later physical integration attempt. The current 224 invoice fails that screen; this bounded gauge family tests whether four-way interaction can change it but cannot update selected kappa or admit a supplier.
stop_rule: Stop after the exact rational support-cell proof for all 24 cycle orders, exact inverse checks for the 193 distinct support pairs, pricing all 46,376 channel quadruples, and dense scalar-identity/wrong-inverse controls. Do not infer a lower bound for arbitrary GL4(Q) matrices, other word orders, longer sequences, other factorizations or physical suppliers.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json and RESULT.json; 408 canonical rational parameter-cell representatives collapse to 193 support pairs; all 8,950,568 pair/quadruple cases have no strict improvement; the all-nonzero cycle stratum has minimum invoice 225; exact 112x112 scalar identity checked for every representative.

open_questions.question: Can a four-channel gauge word that is not ordered around a simple cycle, such as a path with a chord, lower the invoice?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The cycle family is one structured four-channel interaction. Other word orders can create different cancellation cells and remain a possible route below the 224 tariff.
open_questions.first_step: Derive the exact polynomial support cells for a four-factor path-plus-chord word, then price only a discriminating subset of channel quadruples before broadening.
open_questions.blocked_by: The support polynomials can have several competing path monomials; a finite coefficient alphabet would not classify them over Q. Even a lower tariff would still require physical realization, dirty-state restoration and supplier admission.

boundary.source: The authenticated 112 selected P112 ports, exact PR3335 matching and 34 disjoint scalar supports, with K=A A^T.
boundary.operation: On any four of the 34 latent channels, choose an ordering (a,b,c,d) and rational x0,x1,x2,x3; set G=E_ab(x0)E_bc(x1)E_cd(x2)E_da(x3), where E_ij(x)=I+x e_ij. Transform the source columns by G and the reader rows by G^-1.
boundary.preserved: The complete rational 112x112 fitting matrix K and its scalar endpoint.
boundary.priced: For each changed term, the exact F2 pairing rank between complete source-plane and reader-plane spans, counting every term occurrence.
boundary.not_supplied: Other four-channel word orders, arbitrary GL4(Q), longer sequences, other scalar factorizations, native implementation, dirty-helper restoration, physical consumer or supplier admission.

proved: For each of the 24 ordered simple four-cycles, every source and inverse entry is zero or one path monomial, except one source diagonal 1+x0*x1*x2*x3; this exactly classifies support for all rational coefficients by zero-edge mask and the product=-1 cancellation cell.
408 exact rational-cell representatives realize 193 distinct support pairs; all representative matrices have exact inverses.
All 46,376 channel quadruples and 193 support pairs are priced: 8,950,568 cases, with no strict invoice improvement; every quadruple retains minimum 224 over the full rational cycle family.
The all-nonzero cycle stratum has 48 support pairs and minimum global invoice 225; no quadruple improves.
For all 193 representative gauges, all 12,544 scalar fitting entries are exactly preserved; a wrong-inverse mutation is rejected.
unknown: Whether non-cycle-ordered four-channel words, arbitrary GL4(Q) gauges, longer sequences or other factorizations lower the invoice.
Whether a lower-tariff scalar factorization has a legal physical decoder and complete supplier.
obligation_ledger.not_zero_cost_claim: This is an algebraic complete-plane tariff screen only; physical gathering, restoration, chronology, consumers, precision, compilation and supplier costs remain unpriced.
